name: speaker-for-discord
description: Stream Deck plugin showing the currently-speaking member of your Discord voice channel.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dsd/shared && npm run build -w @dsd/helper && npm run build -w @dsd/plugin
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/helper/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/plugin/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
